data.name: Munifah
data.gender_notes: Munifah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'munif', meaning 'one who gives, donor'. In Islam, the virtue of giving is highly emphasized as an act of charity and good deed. The name Munifah carries the meaning “Giver, Donor” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Munifah usually hope their child will grow to embody giver, donor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes generosity and kindness towards others.
data.etymology: Munifah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Giver, Donor.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Munifah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
